name: 93265 · Springville, CA
findings: ZIP 93265 (Springville) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93265 (Springville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
